errors.evidence: The phrase translates to 'changes in the peaks of risk', which is not precise. The chart title is 'Risk Variance from OECD', so it illustrates the deviation or variance of risk levels, not just changes in peaks.
The description of the Y-axis range omits the fact that the scale extends below 0 to a tick mark that would represent -25, as stated in the reference description.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при около 125% през 1980 г.
errors.evidence: The line for Bulgaria starts at a value of approximately 110% in 1980, not 125%.
The maximum value for Bulgaria is visibly higher than 200%, reaching approximately 215-220% around 1994, not 1995.

errors.text_span: В периода 2005–2015 г. линията е почти хоризонтална, с леко намаление от около 30% до около 25%.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend from 2005 to 2015 is incorrect. The value in 2005 is approximately 50%, not 30%. The line shows a significant drop from 2005 to around 2010, after which it becomes horizontal at ~25%.

errors.text_span: Линията за ОИСР е с тъмносин цвят
errors.evidence: The line for OECD is red/brown, as indicated by the legend and the chart itself. It is not dark blue.

errors.text_span: Тя е почти хоризонтална и се намира постоянно при 25% за целия период от 1980 до 2015 г.
errors.evidence: This is a major error. The OECD line is a flat horizontal line at the 0% level, not 25%. The description misinterprets the annotation '(25)' near the 0 mark on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: Това означава, че нивото на риска на ОИСР е постоянно на ниво 25% в този период.
errors.evidence: This conclusion is incorrect because it is based on the preceding error. The OECD risk variance level is constant at 0%, not 25%.
